name: stream-code
description: Show the code you're writing on stream: a clean, themed, syntax-highlighted overlay for OBS and other browser sources, instead of capturing the VS Code window.

commands.title: Stream Code: Settings (theme, header, background, size...)
Stream Code: Open the theme gallery / control panel
Stream Code: Open the overlay in a browser

enumDescriptions: Mocha: Catppuccin Mocha, same as the editor
Kick: black panel and Kick green, matches the song-request overlay
Twitch: Twitch dark with purple accents
Terminal: green phosphor CRT with scanlines, glow and a block cursor
Paper: light card with GitHub-style colours
Glass: frosted translucent panel, pastel colours
Neon: synthwave pink and cyan with glow
Mac: macOS-style window with One Dark colours
Nord: cool blue-grey with an editor-tab header
Gruvbox: warm retro, boxy corners, editor-tab header
Minimal: no panel, no header, no numbers, just the code
streamCode.theme.description: Overlay theme. Preview them all with 'Stream Code: Open the theme gallery' (http://127.0.0.1:7331/?gallery).

streamCode.showHeader.description: Show the file-name bar above the code. (The Minimal theme hides it unless this is set explicitly.)

streamCode.showBackground.description: Draw the panel background, border and shadow. Off: the code floats over the game with a soft text shadow.

streamCode.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines onto extra rows. Off: long lines slide sideways to keep the caret in view.

streamCode.fontSize.description: Code font size in the overlay, in px.

streamCode.lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size.

streamCode.edgeFade.description: Fade the code out at the top and bottom of the overlay: the % of its height that fades at each edge. 0 = hard edges, about 25 = the code dissolves into the game (nice with the background off).

streamCode.tiltX.description: 3D: tilt the panel forward (+) or back (-), in degrees.

streamCode.tiltY.description: 3D: turn the panel to the right (+) or left (-), in degrees.

streamCode.rotate.description: 3D: rotate the panel in its plane, in degrees.

streamCode.perspective.description: 3D: perspective distance in px. Smaller is more dramatic.

streamCode.scale.description: Scale of the whole panel (1 = fills the browser source). Shrink it when a tilted panel gets cut off at the edges.

streamCode.depth.description: 3D: fake thickness in px so a tilted panel looks like a solid slab, plus a light sheen. 0 = flat.

enumDescriptions: Camera: the whole code view zooms in and pans to follow the mouse / text cursor
Lens: a magnifier over the normal view follows the mouse / text cursor
streamCode.zoom.description: Zoom in on the code you're pointing at or editing.

enumDescriptions: Whichever moved last: the mouse or the text cursor
streamCode.zoomFollow.description: What the zoom follows. VS Code doesn't tell extensions where the mouse is, so 'mouse' means where it last rested over code (the moment a hover tooltip would appear) or clicked.

streamCode.zoomOutAfter.description: Seconds without typing, moving or pointing before the zoom eases back out (the lens hides). 0 = stay zoomed.

streamCode.port.description: Local port the overlay connects to (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/). Only listens on 127.0.0.1.

streamCode.bufferLines.description: How many lines above and below the cursor are sent to the overlay. The overlay only shows what fits, this is just scroll buffer.

streamCode.maxLineLength.description: Lines longer than this are cut (with an ellipsis) before they are sent.

streamCode.hideFiles.description: Glob patterns of files that are never broadcast. The overlay shows a lock card instead of their contents.

streamCode.overlayPath.description: Optional: serve this HTML file at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ instead of the bundled overlay. Point it at your repo copy of stream_code.html to tweak the look without reinstalling.
